result.description: Graph database platform; Aura cloud service with Aura API for managing instances, Query API for Cypher over HTTP.
result.auth_detail: Aura API: user-created OAuth2 client credentials (client ID/secret) exchanged at /oauth/token via HTTP Basic for 1-hour Bearer token. Database access (Query API/Bolt): database username/password.
result.access_detail: Each user creates own Aura API credentials in console; all tiers allowed, linked to user account. AuraDB Free is $0 with no card, rate limited to 25 req/min. No app review or listing needed; per-account tokens users create themselves.
result.api_notes: Aura API (api.neo4j.io) covers instance provisioning/management. Query API runs Cypher over HTTPS (supersedes HTTP API, which is not available on Aura). Bolt drivers also exist. Query API auth sub-pages not read.

evidence.quote: The Aura API uses OAuth 2.0 for API authentication.
Authentication to the token endpoint uses HTTP Basic Authentication
All tiers can create Aura API credentials.
API credentials are linked to the user account, inheriting its capabilities and roles.
No credit card or other payment method required
The Aura API allows you to programmatically perform actions on your Aura instances
The Query API allows to execute Cypher statements against a Neo4j server through HTTP requests.
